feeds.title: The Vit Pro Blog
feeds.description: My name is Caroline. I had vitiligo for almost 50 years and created this website in 2010, following my dramatic recovery, to share my experiences with others affected by this skin condition. I will tell you how my vitiligo progressed, how I learned to live with it, and ﻿how﻿ - after almost half a century - I found an effective, natural natural vitiligo treatment that is working.

feeds.title: Vitiliglow
feeds.description: The story so far after nearly 20 years of having the skin condition VITILIGO. I now have white patches on my face, hands, knees and feet. I have tried just about every type of foundation, corrective cosmetic and sunless tanning cream to cover my patches. Vitilglow is a camouflage cover for the skin that is quick and easy to use, comes in natural skin tones and is water resistant.
